coverage.note: Refusal with 401 is u2; u4 offers no guest sign-in and no way to send another identity.
The audit entry itself is written by u2; u4 makes sure the signed-in person is a demo user so the actor can be named.
The single docker compose command is built by u5; u4 makes the app start from settings alone and answer the readiness route.
